body:
Reviewer preparation note for the authorized surface-atlas/v1 slice; no verdict or edit. Three traps in exact base e584ad6:
1. SurfaceAtlas.of cannot establish incoming canonical wire order: SurfaceAtlas.byKind sorts by ordinal before validate reads it. Compare the raw decoded Vector against kind-ordinal then unit-ordinal order before calling of, or a shuffled wire can be silently normalized.
2. A lawful SurfaceAtlas can have cross-kind Vector interleaving while equality includes units order. The canonical artifact may deliberately normalize that, so assert encode/decode/re-encode fixed point and logical units, not decoded == original for a noncanonical in-memory vector unless encode rejects/normalizes by stated contract.
3. If decode accepts Array[Byte], reject malformed UTF-8 rather than allowing replacement-character collapse; the existing Address parser uses decode then exact re-encode byte equality as the portable check. Bind checksum to canonical encoded UTF-8 bytes, not arbitrary accepted input bytes.
I will independently attack schema/source identity, order, duplicate/parent/span cases, raw-different/canonical-same behavior, and text omission when an immutable candidate arrives.
